 'Tis the season for advent calendars! And during the Sephora Savings Event, you can save big on these must-have makeup and skincare sets.
 By Jacqueline Weiss Oct 30, 2026 2:00 PM Tags Deals Shopping Makeup Shop Beauty E! Insider Shop Shop Sales E! Insider Skincare Link Copied Add E! News to Google E! Illustration/Sephora Rouge members, grab your wallets! The Sephora Savings Event has officially begun, and Rouge members have the first opportunity to save big on beauty.
 Not only is the sale the best time for a major restock on all of your makeup, skincare and hair faves, but it's a great time to start shopping for holiday gifts! And nothing screams holiday to us quite like an advent calendar .
 Best for makeup lovers: Charlotte Tilbury Charlotte's Hollywood Beauty Wonderland Advent Calendar 
 Best value: Sephora Collection Premium Advent Calendar 24 Days of Beauty Surprises 
 Best for skincare lovers: LANEIGE 12 Days of Wonder Korean Skincare & Lip Favorites Advent Calendar 
 Just use the code ALLONSALE to save. ICYMI, here's the full sale rundown:
 Sephora Collection:  30% off, Oct. 30-Nov. 9
 Rouge Members: 20% off, Oct. 30-Nov. 9
 VIB: 15% off, Nov. 3-9
 Insider: 10% off, Nov. 3-9
 P.S. Since advent calendars already offer such a great value, this added discount is even more of a win-win for you and your wallet!
 But act quickly! Value sets and advent calendars tend to go fast during this sale, so order ASAP.
